Subject: Consolidated SOC2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough — propose single 2hr session

Hi Elliot / Nina,

Thanks again for running through the intake forms earlier — it looks like Finprove has overlapping requests for a SOC 2 control walkthrough, a DPA evidence review, and the scheduled external pen-test verification. To reduce back-and-forth for your ops and ours, would you be open to a single consolidated 2-hour session where we:

- run a compact SOC 2 controls walkthrough (45–60 min)
- review DPA items and evidence mapping (30 min)
- sync with your pentest vendor for high-level scope & timelines (30 min)

Proposed windows (UTC):
- Tue Apr 25, 14:00–16:00 UTC
- Wed Apr 26, 09:00–11:00 UTC

If those don't work, send 2x 60–90min windows that fit your vendor's availability and we'll stitch together. I'll loop in our security lead and operations so we have engineering and evidence owners on the call.

Attachments: SOC2_Q&A_v1.pdf (current Q&A / evidence map), network-arch-annotated.png (redacted diagram).

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Could we do Wed Apr 26, 08:00–10:00 UTC so PenTestOps can join at 08:00 for the pentest sync and legal jumps in at 09:00 for the DPA review? If Redwood needs engineering to join earlier, please confirm.

I can also share the pen-test kickoff brief if helpful.
